top_signals.title: RBC Flags Risks of Renewed US Strikes on Iran Despite Diplomacy
top_signals.summary: Renewed US military strikes against Iran remain possible despite a flurry of diplomatic activity in recent days ahead of the midterm elections, according to RBC Capital Markets LLC.

top_signals.title: Anthropic’s IPO Plans Draw Skepticism From Australian CIOs
top_signals.summary: Some Australian investment chiefs are expressing caution over the impending blockbuster initial public offering of Anthropic PBC, as the company brings a fresh artificial intelligence bet to the local market.

top_signals.title: Prediction Markets Avoid Australia’s Tough Line on Gambling
top_signals.summary: Australia’s corporate regulator has not received a single application from a prediction market provider to operate in the country, where such platforms would likely face gambling rather than financial regulations.

top_signals.title: Alphabet sinks 10% as it holds 2026 capex unchanged, expects significant increase in 2027
top_signals.summary: Alphabet missed Q3 expectations on earnings and revenue, its first top-and-bottom-line miss in nearly four years.
